title: Ticket creation fails after application release
customer_impact: Multiple customers receive HTTP 500 when creating tickets; read operations remain available.
scope: Create-ticket path only; issue began immediately after application release git-example-regression.

timeline.event: Customer escalation received with request ID nw-demo-1003.
L2 acknowledged and reproduced HTTP 500 on POST /api/tickets.
Database, Redis, RabbitMQ, worker, and readiness checks remained healthy.
Tempo and API logs isolated the exception to the create-ticket application path in the new release.
No safe L2 configuration or operational fix identified; evidence package escalated to development.

evidence: request ID nw-demo-1003 reproduced through Nginx and API logs
GET and readiness paths remain healthy
trace isolates exception to create-ticket application code
resolution: Pending L3/development action; L2 diagnosis complete and operational workaround unavailable.
